versions.changelog:
xhs-voice-collect 1.0.0

- Initial release of a command-line tool for structured retrieval and analysis of public 小红书 (Xiaohongshu) data.
- Supports keyword-based note search, note detail with comments, comment-only extraction, and creator post monitoring.
- Designed to assist content creators, marketers, and analysts with competitive research, trend insights, KOL screening, and reporting.
- Works via Node.js scripts, requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access.
- Includes comprehensive routing, input validation, and user-friendly error handling rules.
- Provides usage guidelines, anti-patterns, and extensive examples for optimal integration and execution.
